panels.scriptSegment: Please enjoy this short educational program
panels.directionNotes: While Dr. Harlow calmly explains the premise of the song, behind him, INTERN, inside the hospital, notices him filming outside from the window, and begins waving/pressing his face on the window/generally just being overly excited until SECRETARY yanks him back. Feel free to play around with all kinds of jokes for intern and secretary across this shot.

Harlow’s expression turns a little more serious and he leans in closer to the camera, reaching out his hand to make a point of following the instructions given. Intern and secretary hijinjks continue in the background.

panels.scriptSegment: to help us best serve you in your visit today.
panels.directionNotes: Dr. Harlow takes a bow and steps aside, motioning to the Hospital’s Doors, which open up as the camera moves toward the hospital and through the door.
The camera reaches outside the check in window. SECRETARY, with her usual deadpan expression greets the viewer.
INTERN excitedly pops up from behind SECRETARY, waving merrily as he sings and greets the viewer.
SECRETARY uninterestedly types some details in on her COMPUTER as she sings, including the NAME “VALUED PATIENT”. Other categories, “Birthday” and “Condition” are empty.
INTERN flops over SECRETARY’s shoulder and TYPES in more details as he sings, writing next to Birthday “Happy!” and Condition: “New Friend!” SECRETARY is taken by surprise.
SECRETARY sings and calmly adjusts the WEBCAM on her desk to capture a photo properly as INTERN sings along merrily.
SECRETARY sings about not smiling too wide with her usual calm. INTERN looks a little nervous as they sing. SECRETARY finishes adjusting the webcam.

SECRETARY and INTERN sing to the viewer. SECRETARY grabs the mouse and hovers over the “TAKE PHOTO” button. INTERN nervously sweats, squints his eyes closed and clasps his hands in prayer as he sings.
SECRETARY clicks. The webcam lets off a small flash. INTERN nervously opens one eye to look at the resulting photo.
The PHOTO develops as INTERN holds it and nervously awaits the results. SECRETARY walks over to check the security cameras, singing disappointedly that they’re down.
INTERN drops the photo as it falls to the floor to turn around and sing that the Cams are down in slight surprise.
SECRETARY sings, adjusting her glasses and insisting to the viewer this is fine.
INTERN gives a nervous thumbs up as they sing. SECRETARY walks back to her computer next to him.

Both INTERN and SECRETARY sing. The camera turns slightly as SECRETARY calmly points to the SECRET AGENT and INTERN proudly points over to the NIGHTGUARD. SECRET AGENT does a cool pose with his gun drawn. SECURITY GUARD munches on a bar of chocolate, unaware he’s supposed to look sharp.
INTERN and SECRETARY are unchanged. SECRET AGENT nudges SECURITY on the side, as he scrambles to look cool for the shot.

SECRETARY shrugs uninterestedly. INTERN looks a bit less confident as he shrugs and sings. SECRET AGENT gets in a cool pose with his gun again, looking embarrassedly at SECURITY, who is blazing his bitten-into chocolate bar like a pistol.

The camera shifts entirely away from the check in desk and into the WAITING ROOM. SECRET AGENT motions to the HALLWAY and calmly asks the viewer to go to their room. Security is back to munching his chocolate.
SECURITY looks up with a mouth covered in chocolate, echoing SECRET AGENT, weakly motioning to the hallway as he sings. SECRET AGENT looks over at security again, losing a little of his cool briefly.
SECRET AGENT calmly sings to the viewer, insisting they know the way, keeping eye contact with the viewer as he quickly produces a handkerchief and cleans the SECURITY’s face.
SECURITY pulls up his phone as he sings, focusing on his phone instead of the viewer. SECRET AGENT frustratedly reaches for his TABLET.

panels.scriptSegment: It might be on fire, haunted, or swarming with monsters
panels.directionNotes: SECURITY and SECRET AGENT sing together as SECRET AGENT points out an illustration on the tablet detailing the many dangers they can face: a room that’s on fire, haunted by ghosts and a BED MONSTER. SECURITY continues to fiddle around on his phone. Include a swiping alt and save the tablet images as separated (do NOT need to be full hi-res panels of their own) - this is a complex alt, but pays as simple base.
SECRET AGENT grins smugly, pushing away the board and ensuring the viewer this is fine as he sings. SECURITY sings and give a weak thumbs up while fiddling with his phone with the other hand.

SECRET AGENT sings as he pulls out a GUN and TASER he was hiding under his sleeves, making an “X” with his arms while holding them in another cool pose. Upon hearing about someone being armed, SECURITY jumps to action, quickly putting away his phone.
SECURITY grabs SECRET AGENT’S TASER as he sings seriously. SECRET AGENT looks a little surprised.
SECRET AGENT spins his PISTOL proudly as he sings. SECURITY searches around the room for an armed assailant.
SECURITY sighs as he sings, relieved at there being no threat as he lowers his taser.
SECURITY and SECRET AGENT sing together, wielding their weapons and standing back-to-back.

SECURITY and SECRET AGENT begin walking together as they sing. SECRET AGENT looks back and motions for the VIEWER to join them and be escorted to their room while SECURITY slots his TASER in his belt.

panels.scriptSegment: Don’t mind the slime upon the walls that slowly grows in size
panels.directionNotes: Moving into the hallway toward the emergency wing’s end room (ROOM 8), SECRETARY and INTERN sing. As they sing, SECRETARY calmly informs the viewer to ignore the slime while INTERN aggressively tries to wipe a glot of slime off the wall.

panels.scriptSegment: Avert your gaze from ceilings when they’re covered up with eyes!
panels.directionNotes: SECRET AGENT and SECURITY GUARD sing. As they sing, SECRET AGENT gets in front of the camera and shields the viewer’s higher viewing with his hands, and SECURITY GUARD shakily holds up his taser to the ceiling while looking down. SECRETARY drips a bottle of cough syrup on the slime as intern continues cleaning.

panels.scriptSegment: And if we see you back again
panels.directionNotes: Moving up to the entrance to ROOM 8, The camera shifts back to a front-facing view. SECRETARY, INTERN, SECRET AGENT and SECURITY walk in front of the viewer, standing to the sides of the ROOM 8 door as they sing and point at the viewer.
SECRETARY, INTERN, SECRET AGENT and SECURITY sing and shrug, embarrassed at the state of the hospital and believing nobody would ever visit twice.
SECRETARY, INTERN, SECRET AGENT and SECURITY sing, opening the door to ROOM 8.
SECRETARY, INTERN, SECRET AGENT and SECURITY sing, calmly motioning to the viewer to enter room 8. We will zoom in on this to make it look like the viewer is entering the room.
HEAD NURSE greets the viewer in ROOM 8, calmly asking the viewer if they feel tired. NURSE stands beside her, smiling and awaiting the answer.
NURSE also asks if the viewer is feeling tired, offering a SPEED UP COLA.
HEAD NURSE asks the viewer if they’re feeling stressed, pushing down NURSE’s hand, as if to deny the need for using a cola right away.
NURSE also asks if the viewer is feeling stressed, offering a cup of COFFEE.

panels.scriptSegment: Are you feeling manic, panicked, sanity in duress?
panels.directionNotes: HEAD NURSE grabs the cup of COFFEE from NURSE as the two sing, asking how the viewer feels.
NURSE sings inquisitively as HEAD NURSE downs the entire cup of COFFEE.
HEAD NURSE sings, breaking the news gently that they can’t treat stress.
NURSE bows in apology that stress can’t be treated.
HEAD NURSE sings, producing a small needle to take a sample.
NURSE sings, excitedly producing a LARGE needle to take a sample.

panels.scriptSegment: We’ll treat one of the 10 ways
panels.directionNotes: HEAD NURSE and NURSE sing, with HEAD NURSE drawing a little blood with the small needle and gently holding a scrambling NURSE back from jamming in the larger needle.
HEAD NURSE deposits the blood sample into a nearby COMPUTER as the two walk away.
DOCTOR calmly walks into view, singing.
SURGEON storms into the room with an unconscious patient.
DOCTOR looks over to the DIAGNOSIS screen, which displays DRIED EYES.
SURGEON sings as he quickly begins to operate on the patient.

panels.scriptSegment: There is no doubt that was the cause of your in-waiting-room fainting!
panels.directionNotes: DOCTOR and SURGEON sing together to the patient in SURGERY as SURGEON continues to operate.
DOCTOR produces EYE DROPS and uses them on the viewer.
SURGEON produces EYE DROPS and uses them on the patient.
DOCTOR scans the viewer with a scanner. The result is GREEN.
SURGEON scans the PATIENT with a scanner. The result is RED. Both are very surprised.

panels.scriptSegment: You’re cured, We’ll mail you the bill,
panels.directionNotes: DOCTOR and SURGEON nervously sing as they rush the viewer out of the room.
DOCTOR and SURGEON nervously wave goodbye to the viewer as they slam the door shut behind them.
DOCTOR and SURGEON gently shoo away the VIEWER as they sing.
DOCTOR and SURGEON get closer up and whisper, extreme fear in their eyes.

panels.scriptSegment: Don’t mind the sound of gunfire, tasers, and unsettling groans
panels.directionNotes: The camera turns around toward the MEDICAL WING, headed toward ROOM 5. HEAD NURSE and NURSE lean in from the left, cautioning the viewer to ignore the sounds of a struggle. SECRET AGENT rushes in the inverse direction of the viewer, back to ROOM 8.

panels.scriptSegment: Ignore the malformed, creeping spectres’ petrifying moans
panels.directionNotes: Getting closer to the MEDICAL WING, DOCTOR and SURGEON lean in and sing while closing their eyes and covering their ears as a STALKER looks over them.

panels.scriptSegment: And if we see you back again,
panels.directionNotes: Moving up to the entrance to ROOM 5, HEAD NURSE, NURSE, DOCTOR and SURGEON walk in front of the viewer, standing to the sides of the ROOM 5 door as they sing and point at the viewer.

panels.scriptSegment: we’ll guess it’s worse at home!
panels.directionNotes: HEAD NURSE, NURSE, DOCTOR and SURGEON sing and lower their heads in sympathy, expressing the idea that the anomalies are probably more dangerous outside the hospital.
SECRETARY, INTERN, SECRET AGENT and SECURITY sing, looking frightened and opening the door to ROOM 5 as a monster’s shadow looms from behind.

SECRETARY, INTERN, SECRET AGENT and SECURITY sing, aggressively motioning for the patient to enter. NOTE: the shadow in the boards is messy due to a layering issue & the cracks in it should not be emulated in the final panel.
PSYCHOLOGIST, singing, lectures the viewer about the animal corporation proudly. There is a sick patient in bed behind him.
PSYCHOLOGIST, singing with eyes gleaming with pride, produces an autographed photo of DR. HARLOW.
PSYCHOLOGIST proudly salutes as he sings.
PARAMEDIC bursts into the room with a SECOND patient on the wheelchair, asking what the goal is.
PSYCHOLOGIST ponders hopefully over Animal Hospital trying to cure all diseases, singing hopefully. PARAMEDIC takes a sample of the PATIENT’S DNA.
PARAMEDIC puts the sample into the computer as PSYCHOLOGIST continues his inspirational future speech.

panels.scriptSegment: Excuse our mess while we assume control…
panels.directionNotes: PSYCHOLOGIST bows embarrassedly as he keeps a smile on. PARAMEDIC waits for the computer to process the sample.
PARAMEDIC turns to the viewer and insists the animal corporation needs lots of control.
PARAMEDIC’s expression turns frustrated, expressing that he has no idea why animal corp needs THIS much control.

panels.scriptSegment: We recognize our services have suffered quite a cut
panels.directionNotes: PARAMEDIC walks up to the viewer, shrugging as he sings. PSYCHOLOGIST walks over to the COMPUTER as it analyzes samples.

panels.scriptSegment: To patients just like these ones you see here…
panels.directionNotes: PARAMEDIC motions to the two patients sick in the room behind him as he sings. As PSYCHOLOGIST looks at the screen, the computer prepares its diagnosis.
The computer diagnoses both patients as CANADIAN. PSYCHOLOGIST speaks sadly and solemnly over this.
PARAMEDIC and PSYCHOLOGIST both produce jars of MAPLE SYRUP as they sing and begin feeding them to the two Canadian patients.

panels.scriptSegment: and we could try more treatments, but
panels.directionNotes: PARAMEDIC and PSYCHOLOGIST continue feeding their patients MAPLE SYRUP as PARAMEDIC wonders about other treatments.

panels.scriptSegment: We’ll cure their ills and all the rest
panels.directionNotes: PARAMEDIC and PSYCHOLOGIST continue feeding their patients MAPLE SYRUP as they cross the other arm over their chest.
The Patients’ eyes bug out, realizing they’re in end-of-life care and freaking out. The other 8 classes who sung previously on the song all shuffle into the room.
ALL 8 previous classes along with PARAMEDIC and PSYCHOLOGIST raise their arms up and sing. The two patients are dismayed.

panels.scriptSegment: Oh god, there’s one on the set-
panels.directionNotes: SUDDENLY, the FIREFIGHTER crashes into the room, being bitten by an ANOMALY which looks like the fainted patient from verse 2, flailing around and screaming. The classes panic. SECRET AGENT nervously tries to shoot, but fires an “IOU BULLETS - SECURITY” flag as SECURITY GUARD freaks out, produces his gun and shoots wildly off-target. Paying as a COMPLEX BASE to cover the multiple fight frames.

panels.scriptSegment: WHO LET ONE ON THE SET-
panels.directionNotes: FIREFIGHTER rolls around as the ANOMALY keeps biting him, rolling in front of the viewer. SECURITY GUARD messes up and fires a bullet into THE VIEWER LENS. It CRACKS, revealing it to be a camera. Paying as a COMPLEX BASE to cover the multiple fight frames.
LIZ peeks out from behind the camera, checking the lens, horrified at the damage done. Pays as a SIMPLE BASE for the multiple Liz frames.
*DR. HARLOW PAUSES THE VIDEO on frame 9K. It is revealed to be titled “AC_PSA_OSM_Take12.MP4”, a prerecorded file on his computer. Zoom out slightly to show harlow watching.

panels.scriptSegment: All of you believed in me
panels.directionNotes: HARLOW sings mournfully, holding a cup of mint tea. He looks over his newspaper proclaiming the opening of the hospital to cure all diseases.
HARLOW tosses the newspaper to the ground disgustedly. RATTHEW briefly exits his hole in Harlow's office to grab the newspaper and scutters back inside the hole.

panels.scriptSegment: On nights like this, I sit and wonder
panels.directionNotes: HARLOW opens a drawer on his desk as he sings, filled with empty platitudes, accolades and awards.
HARLOW closes the drawer, uninterested in further reminiscing.

panels.scriptSegment: But I started it. I’ll finish it.
panels.directionNotes: HARLOW, gathering his determination, solemnly vows to finish what he started.

panels.scriptSegment: One day, I’ll find the cure
panels.directionNotes: HARLOW turns to his faded family picture as he sings.

panels.scriptSegment: Til then, I’ll slave away for one shift
panels.directionNotes: DR. HARLOW solemnly sips his tea as he sings.

The camera slowly zooms out from Harlow's office to the outside of the hospital and the town surrounding it, revealing the hospital to be the one relatively safe haven in an absolutely destroyed town on fire and being ravaged by furious anomalies.
